params.name: since
params.description: Unix timestamp to restrict metrics to those created on or after this time.

params.name: until
params.description: Unix timestamp to restrict metrics to those created on or before this time.

params.name: trend
params.description: Restricts metrics to a specific trend using its ID.

params.name: groups[]
params.description: Metric groups to return. Options: core, email, kiosk, link, sms, web. Default is core.

items.docs: Returns NPS and satisfaction metrics for the project. By default returns core metrics; optionally returns metrics grouped by delivery channel.
